Publish the Simple Hackintosh CLI v3.0.0 release from the main branch.
The v3 CLI package includes the CMD, PowerShell and macOS Terminal launchers, cross-platform hardware inventory, automatic Windows OpCore-Simplify Hardware Sniffer report export with official GitHub SHA-256 verification and optional Authenticode checking, conservative source-linked macOS compatibility analysis, EFI checks, OpenCore version-matched ocvalidate integration, safe backup and comparison tools, privacy-conscious support reports, and the bundled macrecovery downloader source only; Apple Recovery payloads are not included.
